display_title: Bonding if It Rubs and Loving if It Seeps In
description:
**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=791847), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=8266252)  
Hyeondo left his presence on another Earth and came to this Earth. One day, Seon-hwa, a person who can sense Hyeon-do's presence, appears in front of Hyeon-do. Hope arises for Hyeon-do, who was about to return to his hometown without leaving anything behind. ‘Wouldn’t I be able to live like others? Even if you just brush by the collar, it’s a connection. Hyeondo wants to go beyond fate and naturally permeate this place.
